reviews.text: We came to Gala and Ari through a recommendation and we are super grateful to have found them. With just a few sessions, Ari helped us understand Tango much better, translated the canine language for us and gave us clear, realistic guidelines adapted to both our needs and Tango's. We addressed issues that worried us such as barking when someone enters the house, reactivity towards other dogs or people, or communication with the leash and we obtained very good results. I especially highlight that the treatment is always super respectful and we have felt very accompanied, and this makes everything much easier. Ari has become my trusted person for when new challenges come our way, and I recommend her to everyone who asks me about dog training! 💜 Thank you so much and see you soon!
The guy who helped me was super friendly and informative

A year ago, we hired Ari to help us improve some of our dog's behavior. Not only has he improved, but she's also helped us understand him better and made him happier. She's a fantastic professional who clearly loves what she does. She's fully committed and always there to answer any questions you might have, offering advice and more. And she does all this with wonderful kindness. I wholeheartedly recommend her!

I wrote a few days ago because we needed help with our dog. And they literally just left us on read. If they're at least fully booked or don't want to work with us, it wouldn't have cost anything to send a message. Very unprofessional.

Ariadna is a great professional. She has helped us a lot with Jack. We adopted him when he was three years old and he was very scared. This made him a reactive dog with other dogs and with people. Ariadna taught us how to communicate very well with Jack and how to help him. Thank you very much Ariadna!!!
